annotation.title_clean: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee on the Digital Omnibus on AI and the Digital Omnibus
annotation.title_en: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee on the Digital Omnibus on AI and the Digital Omnibus
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (C/2026/3225)
annotation.summary_en: EESC opinion on the Commission's Digital Omnibus and AI Omnibus simplification proposals. It supports risk-based, proportionate simplification while preserving GDPR and AI Act fundamental-rights protections, urges alignment of high-risk deadlines with harmonised standards, backs sandboxes and a strengthened AI Office, and demands social partner involvement. It notes coherence with Machinery and Medical Device rules.
key_provisions_or_claims: Align high-risk AI deadlines with availability of CEN/CENELEC harmonised standards and notified body capacity
Avoid overlapping conformity assessment and liability rules between AI Act and Machinery/Medical Device Regulations
Support AI Office sandboxes and strengthened resources, with social partner consultation
Require worker information and consultation before workplace AI introduction
Keep broad personal data definition and narrow limits on GDPR access rights and automated decisions
